title: Beetle Butler and Unicorn Arch
description: A skeletal butler in a green coat and hat kneels while holding a bubble wand, blowing bubbles toward a large green beetle chained to a stone pedestal. Behind them stands an ornate gothic archway overgrown with vines, containing a starry cosmic portal, floating orbs with scenes of angels, unicorns, and a flaming unicorn.
prompt: A skeletal butler wearing a green tailcoat and fedora kneels on stone ground, holding a bubble pipe in one hand and gesturing toward a large iridescent green beetle chained to a stone pedestal. An ornate gothic cathedral arch covered in ivy frames a cosmic starry portal in the background. Floating transparent bubbles contain miniature scenes of three angels, a white unicorn, and a flaming unicorn. Dark fantasy style with high contrast, intricate linework, and muted green and white highlights on a black background.
